description: Tahap 1 — Data Induk: Build all master-data APIs and UIs — player management, group configuration, admin management, kas categories, activity log, and password management. Requires FEAT-001 (auth, DB, schema). Covers T1.1 through T1.10. Independent from FEAT-003 except T1.2 grup-context resolver which FEAT-003 also needs.
steps: 1. Create `src/db/schema/master.ts` with tables: `pemain` (id, grup_id, nama, no_hp, catatan, bebas_biaya boolean default false, aktif boolean default true, dibuat_pada, diperbarui_pada). Export from `src/db/schema/index.ts`. Run `pnpm db:generate` to create migration.

2. Create `src/features/auth/get-grup-context.ts`: helper that reads the session cookie from request headers, verifies it with `verify-session.ts`, and returns `{ adminId, grupId }`. Throws 401 if no valid session. This is the single grup-context resolver all API routes must use.

3. Create `src/app/api/v1/konfigurasi/route.ts` (GET, PUT): GET returns current konfigurasi_grup for the session's grup. PUT validates body with Zod (all fields integer, non-negative), upserts konfigurasi_grup. Return standard response.

4. Create `src/app/api/v1/pemain/route.ts` (GET, POST): GET uses `parseListQuery` for pagination/search/sort on `pemain.nama`, returns paginated list scoped to grup_id. POST validates nama (required), no_hp (optional), catatan (optional), bebas_biaya (optional boolean), inserts new pemain.

5. Create `src/app/api/v1/pemain/[id]/route.ts` (GET, PUT, DELETE): GET returns single pemain. PUT updates nama, no_hp, catatan, bebas_biaya. DELETE sets aktif=false (soft delete — never hard delete). All scoped to grup_id.

6. Create `src/app/api/v1/admin/route.ts` (GET, POST): list all admins for grup, add new admin (nama, email, password hashed). Create `src/app/api/v1/admin/[id]/route.ts` (PUT, DELETE): PUT updates nama/email; DELETE sets aktif=false but rejects if this is the only active admin.

7. Create `src/app/api/v1/admin/[id]/reset-password/route.ts` (POST): another admin resets target admin's password. Requires alasan in body. Create `src/app/api/v1/auth/change-password/route.ts` (POST): admin changes own password (requires current password verification).

8. Create `src/app/api/v1/kategori-kas/route.ts` (GET, POST) and `src/app/api/v1/kategori-kas/[id]/route.ts` (PUT, DELETE): GET lists all categories for grup. POST creates new custom category. PUT updates non-system categories. DELETE soft-deletes but rejects if `adalah_sistem=true`.

9. Create `src/features/activity-log/log-activity.ts`: async helper `logActivity({ grupId, adminId, aksi, entitas, entitasId, detail, alasan })` that inserts a row to `log_aktivitas`. All mutating API handlers must call this.
10. Create `src/app/api/v1/log/route.ts` (GET): paginated list of `log_aktivitas` scoped to grup_id, sorted by dibuat_pada DESC, with search on `aksi`.

11. Create `src/app/(protected)/lainnya/konfigurasi/page.tsx`: form with all konfigurasi fields. On submit calls PUT /api/v1/konfigurasi, shows success/error toast. On mount calls GET /api/v1/konfigurasi to prefill.

12. Create `src/app/(protected)/pemain/page.tsx` (replaces placeholder): list view with search input, paginated cards. Each card shows nama, status (aktif/nonaktif), bebas_biaya badge. Floating Action Button to add player. Tap card to open edit bottom sheet.

13. Create `src/components/pemain/PemainForm.tsx`: reusable form bottom sheet for add/edit pemain. Fields: nama (required), no_hp, catatan, bebas_biaya toggle. Uses Zod client-side validation. On submit calls POST or PUT endpoint.
14. Create `src/app/(protected)/lainnya/admin/page.tsx`: list of admins with add admin bottom sheet. Each admin row has deactivate button (guarded: cannot deactivate self if sole active admin).

15. Create `src/app/(protected)/lainnya/kategori-kas/page.tsx`: list of kas categories with tipe (pemasukan/pengeluaran) badges. System categories shown with lock icon (no delete). Add/edit bottom sheet for custom categories.
16. Create `src/app/(protected)/lainnya/log/page.tsx`: paginated log list showing aksi, entitas, admin nama, alasan, dibuat_pada. Search by aksi.
17. Create `src/app/(protected)/lainnya/page.tsx` (replaces placeholder): menu list with navigation links to Konfigurasi, Admin, Kategori Kas, Log, Ubah Kata Sandi.
18. Create `src/app/(protected)/lainnya/ubah-kata-sandi/page.tsx`: form with current password, new password, confirm new password. Calls POST /api/v1/auth/change-password.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm db:generate` creates migration for `pemain` table successfully
GET /api/v1/pemain returns paginated list scoped to grup_id
POST /api/v1/pemain with missing `nama` returns 422 with { message, errors }
DELETE /api/v1/admin/{id} returns 400 when target is the only active admin
All 5 Lainnya sub-pages render without errors at 360px
`pnpm build` completes with zero errors after this FEAT
findings: All 18 steps implemented. Fixed Zod v4 incompatibility: z.enum does not accept `errorMap` — replaced with `error` string param. pnpm db:generate created migration for pemain table (8 tables total). pnpm build passed with zero TypeScript errors, all 24 routes rendered. pnpm vitest run: 8/8 tests passed.
